nodes.summary: For a natural number $h$, a group $G$ has Fitting height (nilpotent length) at most $h$ if there are normal subgroups $1 = G_0 \le G_1 \le \cdots \le G_h = G$ of $G$ such that for every $i < h$ some term of the lower central series of $G_{i+1}$ lies in $G_i$, that is, $G_{i+1} / G_i$ is nilpotent.
nodes.title: Groups of Fitting height at most $h$

nodes.summary: For subgroups $A$ and $B$ of a group $G$, $A / B$ is a chief factor of $G$ if $A$ and $B$ are normal in $G$, $B < A$, and every normal subgroup $N$ of $G$ with $B \le N \le A$ equals $B$ or $A$.
nodes.title: Chief factors

nodes.summary: A group $S$ is a composition factor of a group $K$ if $S$ is simple and some subnormal subgroup $H$ of $K$ has a surjective homomorphism onto $S$.
nodes.title: Composition factors via subnormal subgroups

nodes.summary: A group $G$ is conjugacy separable if any two elements $x, y \in G$ whose images are conjugate in every quotient $G / N$ by a normal subgroup $N$ of finite index (that is, $g x g^{-1} y^{-1} \in N$ for some $g \in G$) are conjugate in $G$.
nodes.title: Conjugacy separable groups

nodes.summary: A family $\sigma = (\sigma_i)_{i \in I}$ of sets of natural numbers is a partition of the primes if every $\sigma_i$ is a nonempty set of primes, $\sigma_i$ and $\sigma_j$ are disjoint whenever $i \ne j$, and every prime lies in some $\sigma_i$.
nodes.title: Partitions of the primes

nodes.summary: For a natural number $p$, a group $G$ is residually a finite $p$-group if every element $g \ne 1$ of $G$ lies outside some normal subgroup of $G$ whose index is $p^k$ for some $k \ge 0$, where an infinite index counts as $0$.
nodes.title: Residually finite $p$-groups

nodes.summary: For a family $\sigma = (\sigma_i)_{i \in I}$ of sets of natural numbers, a group $G$ is $\sigma$-nilpotent if it is the internal direct product of finitely many normal subgroups $H_1, \dots, H_t$ whose orders are $\sigma$-primary (the order of an infinite subgroup counts as $0$): the $H_k$ generate $G$, and each $H_k$ meets the subgroup generated by the others trivially.
nodes.title: $\sigma$-nilpotent groups

nodes.summary: For a family $\sigma = (\sigma_i)_{i \in I}$ of sets of natural numbers, a natural number $n$ is $\sigma$-primary if there is an index $i$ such that every prime divisor of $n$ lies in $\sigma_i$. For $n = 0$ this means that some $\sigma_i$ contains every prime.
nodes.title: $\sigma$-primary numbers

nodes.summary: For a family $\sigma = (\sigma_i)_{i \in I}$ of sets of natural numbers, a group $G$ is $\sigma$-soluble if for every chief factor $A / B$ of $G$ the index $|A : B|$ is $\sigma$-primary (an infinite index counts as $0$).
nodes.title: $\sigma$-soluble groups

nodes.summary: For a family $\sigma = (\sigma_i)_{i \in I}$ of sets of natural numbers, a subgroup $A$ of a group $G$ is $\sigma$-subnormal in $G$ if there is a chain of subgroups $A = A_0 \le A_1 \le \cdots \le A_n = G$ such that for every $i < n$ either $A_i$ is normal in $A_{i+1}$, or the index in $A_{i+1}$ of the normal core of $A_i$ in $A_{i+1}$ is $\sigma$-primary (an infinite index counts as $0$).
nodes.title: $\sigma$-subnormal subgroups

nodes.summary: For groups $A$ and $B$, let $A \wr_r B = A^B \rtimes B$ be the regular (unrestricted) wreath product, where $A^B$ is the group of all functions $f : B \to A$ and $b \in B$ acts on it by $(b \cdot f)(x) = f(b^{-1} x)$. The restricted wreath product $A \wr B$ is the subgroup of $A \wr_r B$ generated by the elements $(f, b)$ whose function part $f$ has finite support, that is, $f(x) \ne 1$ for only finitely many…
nodes.title: Restricted wreath product

nodes.summary: The statement of Kourovka Problem 19.84 is false: there are a partition $\sigma$ of the set of primes, a finite group $G$ and a subgroup $A$ of $G$ such that $A$ is $\sigma$-subnormal in the subgroup $\langle A, A^x \rangle$ generated by $A$ and $A^x = xAx^{-1}$ for every $x \in G$, but $A$ is not $\sigma$-subnormal in $G$.
nodes.title: A counterexample to Skiba's $\sigma$-subnormality question

nodes.summary: The statement that for every partition $\sigma$ of the set of primes, every finite group $G$ and every subgroup $A$ of $G$, if $A$ is $\sigma$-subnormal in the subgroup $\langle A, A^x \rangle$ generated by $A$ and $A^x = xAx^{-1}$ for every $x \in G$, then $A$ is $\sigma$-subnormal in $G$.
nodes.title: Skiba's $\sigma$-subnormality question (Kourovka 19.84)

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
